about: Ten useful AI tips as a pocket field guide. A full-bleed cover scene, then cream pages: a large green number, the real tool logo in a framed tile, the task in ink and green capitals, up to three numbered steps, and who it suits. An ink strip at the foot carries the page count and the house mark. Sources, dates and logo credits go in the post description.
